summary: Applied a fix in session-operations.ts adding an optional-check around session.navigateTree and its cancelled-result handling, after an initial exact-text match failure was resolved by re-reading the file. Updated FakeAgentClient.test.ts to use a fresh session id and tightened assertions around branching to the original prompt.
decisions: In session-operations.ts branch flow, when entryId is null and no first user entry is found, treat session.navigateTree as optional: only call it if defined and return early with the repository snapshot if the navigation reports cancelled.

In FakeAgentClient.test.ts, capture the original prompt's id from the assistant response metadata rather than from the initial user message, and pass store.sessionId (non-null) directly to getSessionTree.
errors: First edit attempt to session-operations.ts failed with 'Could not find the exact text' due to whitespace/newline mismatch; resolved by re-reading the file and re-issuing the edit successfully.
